### 2026-11-01: In this session, I was mainly editing tolerances, but I also added the stabilizer holes and replaced the tabs for the plate with the ones in the correct positions. At first, I was researching how exac

**4.1h**

In this session, I was mainly editing tolerances, but I also added the stabilizer holes and replaced the tabs for the plate with the ones in the correct positions. At first, I was researching how exactly the extenders were going to snap into the keyboard because I realized there were many ways they could go wrong and not work as intended. Then I had to move the tab for the plate and add another one for it. At the end, I added the holes for the stabilizers. This took a while because Google AI was giving me garbage dimensions and then eventually I had the thought to switch to a different AI (it was late, OK?). All throughout this I had to do the excruciating process of redoing constraints and tolerances.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/7864493b-2dab-47e9-b97d-72efa8f5f432/video.mp4)
